record_scope_reconstruction: Ukraine-to-Romania freight admission on the Dyakove–Halmeu road route was suspended while tractors obstructed the Romanian approach. Passenger road traffic continued; nearby Halmeu railway facility is outside scope.

source_checks.finding: January18 report quotes customs on farm machinery before Halmeu and protective Ukrainian suspension of departing trucks to avoid blocking passenger vehicles.
January20 notification restores Halmeu, the final Romanian truck blockade after Vicovu and Siret. Notification time is not exact first vehicle passage.
Official directory distinguishes Halmeu Rutier road marker from Halmeu Feroviar rail marker about1.2km southwest. Ukrainian protective truck suspension relates to paired Dyakove road route.
